Installation guide ↗↗

Before you start

Ask on GitHub↗
What does Yukio do?+

Yukio keeps you company while you work with Codex, Claude Code or Deep Code. She turns reading, writing and waiting into little everyday movements, and lets you know when your attention is needed.

Can I start with just the companion?+

Yes. Choose your character and let her follow your supported AI tools. Workbench explanations are optional and need a compatible service to be set up.

What if macOS blocks the first launch?+

The Mac app is not Apple notarized. If macOS blocks it, follow the first-launch steps in the installation guide. Download only from a source you trust.

Which computers can Yukio live on?+

Apple silicon Mac supports Yukio 5.3 with the activity workbench. Intel Mac has the 0.4.6 desktop companion. A Windows download is not available.

Does this website read my chats?+

No. You can play with the characters here without connecting your assistants or sharing your chats. To follow your work, install Yukio and choose an assistant in the app.
